implementation.status: CPU-gated local implementation only; not activated by a trainer and no lambda was selected or measured
implementation.scope: Independent PyTorch implementation of the pinned LeJEPA MINIMAL SIGReg objective; no source code copied
implementation.input_api: [B, D] or [V, B, D]; views are evaluated independently over B and averaged
numerical_policy: float32 objective path with autocast disabled
no batch standardization, centering, normalization, or unbiased estimator correction
no distributed reduction, clipping, or trainer integration
quadrature uses t=linspace(0, 3, 17), endpoint half-weights, and Gaussian weight exp(-t^2/2)
random Gaussian projection columns are L2-normalized
private CPU generator state is serialized as module extra state; global RNG is not consumed
implementation.formula: A ~ N(0,1)^(D x K), A_:k <- A_:k / ||A_:k||2; x_t=(X A) t; err=(mean_B cos(x_t)-exp(-t^2/2))^2 + mean_B sin(x_t)^2; SIGReg=mean_K [ B * sum_j w_j err_j ], with symmetry-doubled trapezoid weights on [0,3]
implementation.api_extensions: Optional fixed directions [D,K] and caller-owned torch.Generator are replay/testing hooks; they do not alter the default objective.

primary_source.fetch_method: Python urllib.request with certifi CA bundle where available

attribution_and_license.citation: Balestriero and LeCun, LeJEPA: Provable and Scalable Self-Supervised Learning Without the Heuristics, arXiv:2511.08544

The source, authors, immutable commit, license text, and inconsistency are recorded here and in the local receipt bundle. Review licensing before redistribution or commercial use.

verification.environment: CPU only; existing project environment; no dependency changes
checks: fixed-direction numerical parity against the pinned MINIMAL formula
finite positive zero/shift/scale behavior and nonzero finite gradients
private generator replay and state_dict restoration without global RNG consumption
invalid shape, non-finite, and singleton-batch validation
verification.lambda: unmeasured; no coefficient selected and no training run performed
